name: konoha
source: Ninja Duel's village walk (Client/HubClient: Hub.WALK, Hub.RUN, Hub.JUMP, Hub.LEAP) and the place's gravity (build.py: Workspace.Gravity 140). 19/11, for SyphoDev's prover.
note: The prover models one jump. Konoha has a second one (the LEAP: double tap space, vertical speed set to 54 in the air once per jump). jumpPower below is the single jump that reaches the same top: jump 56 to its apex (56^2/280 = 11.2) then the leap (54^2/280 = 10.41) = 21.61 studs, i.e. sqrt(2*140*21.61) = 77.8. Its airtime (1.11 s) is SHORTER than the real jump+leap (about 1.34 s), so the horizontal reach is conservative.

slideEntryCap.note: the prover's generous envelope takes off at this speed: Hub.RUN, the fastest the village walk goes

maxWalkSlope.note: Humanoid.MaxSlopeAngle default (HubClient does not set it)

ragdollRecovery.note: no ragdoll while walking in Konoha
